title: Col. Macgregor: No One Will Rescue America This Time — The 1914 Trap Explained
summary: Col. Douglas Macgregor compares the US in the 2026 Iran war to Britain in 1914, says air and naval power cannot win, Iran holds the initiative and China helps Iran short of war.

assertions.quote: naval power is not going to decide the outcome of this war. Neither is air power.

verdicts.note: Air campaigns rarely compel a regime to capitulate, and Iran had not capitulated after weeks of US and Israeli strikes.
Six weeks of US-Israeli strikes failed to subdue Iran, which kept refusing US conditions until a ceasefire imposed largely by its closure of Hormuz.

assertions.quote: if you actually try to do that, you're going to end up in a war with China.

verdicts.note: China has supplied Iran but avoided any military clash with the US during the war, and forecasters see a US-China war as unlikely in the near term.

assertions.quote: I think the Chinese are as involved as they can be short of going to war against the United States.
there's nobody in Beijing and nobody in Moscow that wants to go to war with the United States.

verdicts.note: What leaders in Beijing and Moscow want is not on the public record; their behaviour shows caution but not intent.

DDIS describes US-China preparations for a confrontation 'that neither side wants'; it says Russia sees itself in conflict with NATO and prepares for a possible war, without judging whether it wants one with the US.

assertions.quote: We've discarded all the uh all of the uh peace uh not peacekeeping but uh arms control regimes that we formerly relied on.
Those bases are no longer useful. Why are they not useful? Because they can be easily attacked and destroyed

verdicts.note: Precision strike makes fixed bases more vulnerable, but air defences and hardening mean US bases in the Gulf were hit, not wiped out, in 2025-26.

In CSIS's wargame Chinese missiles destroyed about 90% of US, Japanese and Taiwanese aircraft losses on the ground at crowded, unhardened bases; this covers China, not Iran, and CSIS says hardening and dispersion would reduce it.

assertions.quote: We're involved in this war because of Israel because of Mr. Netanyahu

verdicts.note: This is a claim about motive; Israeli pressure was one factor among stated US aims on Iran's nuclear and missile programs.

assertions.quote: So if he doesn't if he doesn't come to terms with that, what do you do, Mario? You remove the president.

verdicts.note: Removal needs two-thirds of the Senate and no US president has ever been removed; the base rate is near zero.
